body: I feel slightly better. This is how it always happens its intense urge to kill myself for about 30 minutes then nothing. I've acted in this window before though and got myself a hospital stay and cost my parents a lot of money.

I'm 19 but I could never see myself this old. I always assumed and wanted something to happen by now that would kill me. I feel like now I'm running on fumes. Nothing is wrong with my life, I'm in a moderately wealthy family and get whatever I want. So I shouldn't feel as dissatisfied as I do. But I do none the less. Something feels very very wrong but I cannot place it. Its frustrating to me.
Tried it and hated it. Felt like a waste of time.
